blurb: Ariel Dance Productions offers a wide range of dance classes including Jazz, Tap, Ballet, Contemporary, Lyrical, Broadway Jazz, Hip Hop, K Pop, Bollywood, Indian Semi Classical, Burlesque Cabaret, Latin, and Performance Teams. Classes are designed for youth, teens, and adults and include opportunities for performance in bi-annual dance concerts.
